name: io.github.Bishop81/accessibility-scanner-mcp
description: Scan any URL for WCAG accessibility issues (axe-core) and get per-element fixes for an AI agent. Runs locally with your browser, or with no browser via SCANNER_API_URL.

environmentVariables.name: CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Chrome/Chromium/Edge binary. Only needed if auto-detection picks the wrong one.

environmentVariables.name: SCANNER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Set to https://accessibilityscanner.app to run scans on the hosted scanner instead of a local browser. No account needed. Sends the scanned URL to that server.

environmentVariables.name: SCANNER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional API token for higher hosted rate limits. Not required today.
